references.observed: August 2018 owner aerial shows the low powerhouse, sloping concrete supports, separate crown road, two blue gantries, white control tower and angular downstream quay walls.
June 2021 lock photo shows deep vertical chamber walls, upstream cross gate, downstream miter leaves and two yellow operating columns.
Historical operator bulletin provides representative Kyiv Reservoir and lower Dnipro cascade stage ranges.
January 2026 government release includes the Kyiv HPP and PSP cascade in the recovery program. The model uses the dated published exterior references.
The native crown road and headwater and tailwater boundaries locate the plant. The two mapped lock polygons establish the independent lock axis.
